models.collectorNote: Among the most valuable American cars, period — most sales are private and most cars sit in museums. Chassis-number provenance is absolute; the registry of the 51 is the market.

generations.name: Tucker 48 ('Torpedo')
generations.note: Fifty-one cars were completed including the prototype, most of which survive. The 5.5-litre flat-six, adapted from a Franklin helicopter engine, drove the rear wheels through a Cord-derived transaxle.

models.intro: The 'Tin Goose' prototype and fifty production cars: a rear-engined, flat-six sedan years ahead of Detroit — padded dash, pop-out windscreen, a third headlight that turned with the steering, and a corporation that became a courtroom legend.
